item.title: An Arcade Machine (Mostly) From Scratch
item.description: This project is one that has been in development for a few years now, and it probably won’t be finished for a few more. It is one that has grown in scope considerably, and is really the result of several smaller projects. Currently, the end goal is to have a fully working arcade machine of my very own - running a game I wrote on hardware I built. The project began at the end of grade school when I decided to try making my own fighting game.
